n11_claim: N11 Sec.1 Core Invariance Theorem: interaction coefficient identical across centering
finding: N11's theorem is algebraically correct but conditional on the design spanning the lower-order constituents of every interaction. Centering expands (kappa-k0)(omega-w0)D into kappa.omega.D - k0(omega.D) - w0(kappa.D) + k0.w0.D, so invariance requires omega.D and kappa.D in the design. US_S33D carries kappa.D but not omega.D; US_S33E carries neither. In both, the centering regime is a MODEL choice, not a conditioning choice. A linear trend in deter does not address this.
